name: Mežinieki (Alūksne)
source: Course sign at Mežinieki sports centre; positions fitted to LKS-92 via the road, the 'you are here' dot (57.41298 N, 27.08243 E) and the sign's hole lengths; 1 m terrain decoded from the LGIA hillshade, replaced by LGIA LiDAR tile 4442-43-31 ground (class 2) at 1 m; west strip from the 20 m DTM (+20 E, -10 N corrected); trees from the sign, heights from the canopy height model.
